list.name: service
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service FROM events WHERE type = 'scenario.completed' ORDER BY service;

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'retrieved_final')::int)::int AS "1. Retrieved" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'dedup_post')::int)::int AS "2. После dedup" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'sources_shown')::int)::int AS "3. Источников показано" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'sources_used')::int)::int AS "4. Источников использовано" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)

SELECT '1. Retrieved' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'retrieved_final')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '2. После dedup' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'dedup_post')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '3. Источников показано' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'sources_shown')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '4. Источников использовано' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'sources_used')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY 1;

SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->'scenario'->>'sources_used')::int > 0) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) AS conv FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)

SELECT received_at AS "Время", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", data AS "Запрос", payload->'scenario'->>'answer_path' AS "Path", (payload->'scenario'->>'retrieved_final')::int AS "Retrieved", (payload->'scenario'->>'dedup_post')::int AS "Dedup", (payload->'scenario'->>'sources_shown')::int AS "Shown", (payload->'scenario'->>'sources_used')::int AS "Used", round((payload->'scenario'->>'top_score')::numeric,3) AS "TopScore" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", data AS "Запрос", (payload->'scenario'->>'retrieved_final')::int AS "Retrieved", (payload->'scenario'->>'dedup_post')::int AS "Dedup", (payload->'scenario'->>'sources_shown')::int AS "Shown", CASE   WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'retrieved_final')::int = 0 THEN 'no_documents (retrieval пуст)'   WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'early_return_reason' IS NOT NULL THEN payload->'scenario'->>'early_return_reason'   WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'sources_shown')::int = 0 THEN 'all_filtered (dedup/threshold)'   ELSE 'llm_no_citation (ответ без ссылок)' END AS "Причина" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'sources_used')::int = 0 AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50;
